notable_absence.finding: Unlike rest_api_public.md (this round's sibling file), where an RBAC-role requirement appears exactly once across ~40 endpoints and only on a deprecated/non-functional stub, BOTH Metrics REST API endpoints here (Prometheus /metrics and JSON /_expvar) consistently and identically declare 'Required Sync Gateway RBAC roles: Sync Gateway Architect / Sync Gateway Dev Ops / External Stats Reader'. This is real, repeated corroboration - not a stray artifact - of sgw:metrics-rest-api's promoted description ('gated through the same Server-RBAC-reused identity system as the Admin REST API'), and it names three specific Couchbase-Server-RBAC role labels not seen elsewhere in this batch: Sync Gateway Architect, Sync Gateway Dev Ops, and External Stats Reader - finer-grained than the generic sgw:rbac-user concept currently models, a candidate refinement for a future round if per-role Admin/Metrics RBAC roles are found named again elsewhere. The /_ping endpoint under the Server tag, by contrast, declares no role requirement at all, mirroring its identical Public-API counterpart.

cross_component_finding: The JSON metrics sample's syncGateway_db group directly names several already-promoted internal mechanisms by their metric-key form - revisionCache_adds/hits/misses (sgw:revision-cache), and the per_replication group's sgr_active/sgr_docs_checked_sent/sgr_num_docs_pushed fields (sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication) - giving concrete, quotable confirmation that those internal components are directly observable through this API. The syncGateway_changeCache group (maxPending, lag-tap-0000ms, lag-queue-0000ms, lag-total-0000ms, outOfOrder, view_queries) names a distinct internal cache with no existing promoted concept - not to be confused with the already-promoted sgw:channel-cache (an Enterprise-Edition-tunable channel-to-document routing cache with a stated tombstone-ejection quirk); the change cache tracked here appears to be the feed-lag/pending-sequence tracking structure behind sgw:changes-feed instead, corroborating the Public API's own 'roundtrip' query parameter description ('Block until document has been received by change cache') from this round's sibling file.
cross_product_finding: sgw:prometheus-metrics-format's own registry description already states it follows 'the same pattern documented for the rest of the Couchbase product line' - this page's Prometheus sample output (go_gc_duration_seconds, go_gc_gogc_percent, etc.) is generic Go-runtime Prometheus Exposition Format, identical in shape to what any other Couchbase Go-based service would expose via prometheus:metrics-endpoint, reinforcing that Sync Gateway's Prometheus surface is a standard client-library output rather than a bespoke format - the product-line-wide convention this batch was asked to confirm.
